headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United, Arsenal eye Bournemouth's Tavernier
description: Arsenal and Man United are set to go head-to-head for Marcus Tavernier. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Chelsea's Xabi Alonso 'very happy' with Cole Palmer despite England omission
description: Xabi Alonso said he has no time to spend worrying about international call-ups for his players after Cole Palmer was omitted from the England's Nations League squad.

headline: Unai Emery confirms new contract talks with Aston Villa
description: Aston Villa boss Unai Emery confirmed there have been talks to build a "stronger" project at the club by signing a new contract at Villa Park.

headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta praises Declan Rice's 'desperate' determination to improve
description: Mikel Arteta has lauded Declan Rice's "desperate" determination to improve after the midfielder was one of five Arsenal players called up to Thomas Tuchel's England squad.

headline: Roberto De Zerbi: Tottenham rising star Luca Williams-Barnett ready to start matches
description: Roberto De Zerbi believes Tottenham's highly-rated youngster Luca Williams-Barnett is ready to start matches.
